scene_bible: A 28-year-old woman with a slim build, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, warm medium skin, oval face, and small silver hoop earrings sits facing the camera in a tidy apartment living room. She wears a cream knit cardigan over a plain olive T-shirt. Behind her are a gray fabric sofa, a wooden side table with a ceramic lamp, a leafy potted plant, and softly blurred framed prints on a beige wall. Natural afternoon light comes from a window to camera left, with gentle fill light on her face. Medium close-up framing from mid-chest upward, static camera, shallow depth of field, realistic talking-head style.

clips.dialogue: I left my husband after realizing love had become permission to disappear.
At first, I called his control concern, and my silence compromise.
Then I found my old journals and barely recognized that woman.
So one morning, I packed two bags before he woke up.
Leaving hurt, but staying would have cost me my whole self.
